DDL:
CREATE TABLE metadata (
 singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (singleton = 1),
 schema_version TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (schema_version = '1'),
 chain_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 event_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(event_count) = 'integer' AND event_count BETWEEN 0 AND 4096),
 head_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(head_hash) = 64 AND head_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
 canonical_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(canonical_bytes) = 'integer' AND canonical_bytes BETWEEN 0 AND 33554432)
)

CREATE TABLE events (
 sequence INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (sequence BETWEEN 1 AND 4096),
 event_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
 kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('request','model_declaration','tool_call','tool_result','feature_read','decision','human_review','cancellation','error','correction')),
 previous_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(previous_hash) = 64 AND previous_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
 digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(digest) = 64 AND digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
 canonical BLOB NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(canonical) = 'blob' AND length(canonical) BETWEEN 1 AND 16384),
 byte_length INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(byte_length) = 'integer' AND byte_length = length(canonical))
)

automatic_indexes.events: unique event_id index; fixed collation BINARY, no partial/expression index

open_pragmas: Query existing journal_mode and version IDs first; reject unsupported mode/version without assigning/converting. Configure/verify only supported connection-local settings. SQLite hot-journal recovery may physically write; no application logical repair.
public_signatures: Checkpoint(chain_id: str, sequence: int, head_hash: str)
verify_events(events: list[EventRecord] | tuple[EventRecord, ...], *, chain_id: str, expected: Checkpoint | None = None) -> Verification
verify_page(page: Page, *, start: Checkpoint, through: Checkpoint, prior: list[EventRecord] | tuple[EventRecord, ...] = ()) -> PageVerification
Ledger.verify(*, expected: Checkpoint | None = None) -> Verification
Ledger.export_page(*, after: int, through: Checkpoint, limit: int = 64) -> Page
path_policy: Exact nonempty absolute str <=4096characters, no NUL. Internally construct quoted mode=rw URI for opening; caller supplies no URI/options. Creation reserves new file exclusively, refuses existing destinations and leaves failed owned initialization for explicit caller cleanup. No adversarial race-free path/ACL guarantee.
corruption_policy: Validate exact DDL/column/index inventories before application table reads. Full verification rejects canonical,row mirror,sequence,reference,global ID,metadata/index or bounds disagreement; never application-repair/migrate/delete. Anchor coverage separate from integrity.
page_policy: Explicit fixed through terminal on every call. At most64events/1MiB canonical bytes, contiguous recording sequence. Verify through row hash in each consistent read snapshot, exclude later appends. Empty only after==through. Page checks cannot establish earlier global uniqueness or earlier references outside supplied context. Full verify_events from genesis checks global uniqueness/references once linearly. verify_page requires the caller explicit expected through as well as start; self-declared Page.through must equal it before reached_terminal may be true. A self-chosen page terminal cannot satisfy the caller terminal request.
close_policy: Idempotent connection close; methods on poisoned/closed object refuse. A close/rollback failure is not completed physical cleanup. No automatic file/journal deletion or recursive cleanup.
empty_verification: verify_events requires explicit chain_id even for empty input; empty head=(chain_id,0,genesis), no anchor=>not_supplied, expected samechain genesis=>matched_terminal, expected later=>not_covered, wrongchain=>mismatch. Ledger.verify supplies its bound chain identity.
transaction_connection: CPython3.12 sqlite3.connect(internally quoted owner path URI, uri=True, timeout=0.0, isolation_level=None, autocommit=sqlite3.LEGACY_TRANSACTION_CONTROL); fixed BEGIN IMMEDIATE/COMMIT/ROLLBACK SQL. Separate connections per writer/thread; no shared-connection concurrency promise.
public_error_class: LedgerError(ValueError) with exact closed payload-free code; input AgentEvidenceError mapped: invalid_schema->invalid_schema, unsupported_version->unsupported_version, duplicate->duplicate, limit_exceeded->limit_exceeded, invalid_reference/inconsistent_reference->inconsistent_reference. Stored-event decode/hash/mirror disagreement maps to inconsistent_chain. Raw SQLite causes remain private; SQLITE_BUSY or SQLITE_LOCKED (base code including extended variants) map to busy before a possible commit.
append_acknowledgment: Checkpoint returned only after COMMIT success. Any COMMIT exception poisons/closes and outcome_unknown even if in_transaction becomes false. Precommit failure returns known refusal only after successful rollback; failed/uncertain rollback poisons/closes and outcome_unknown. Never auto replay. Record exact proposal/prior checkpoint externally and use read-only reconcile after reopen.
head_policy: head() returns a validated stored checkpoint/head-row pair, not a fresh whole-history verification or authenticated anchor. verify()/open perform full consistency scanning. Close is idempotent API state; a failed underlying close is not a physical cleanup success.
page_construction: Page structural construction revalidates/copies checkpoint fields and exact list/tuple event input (stored as tuple), count/byte caps. Relations/linkage/coverage are verified by verify_page/export, not implied by an arbitrary caller-created Page.
reference_order: Semantic kind order: tool_call request; tool_result call; feature_read result; decision request then feature_reads; human_review decision; cancellation target; error optional target; correction target then optional replacement. Return unique resolved/unresolved references in first-citation order, matching content only; earlier membership/global uniqueness not verified by a page.

AnchorStatus.type: Enum, exact class; strings and other enums refused

ReconciliationStatus.type: Enum, exact class; strings and other enums refused

common.ownership: Frozen records; exact own record/enum types only, never subclasses. Revalidate fields even for forged instances. Clone checkpoint fields and EventReference fields; detach events through public encode/decode. Exact list/tuple inputs stored as detached tuples. No caller-owned mutable container retained.
common.errors: Wrong type/shape, bool-as-int, negative count -> invalid_schema; count over cap -> limit_exceeded; input event/reference errors mapped through public_error_class. Validation in signature field order, container caps before item validation, then cross-field rules in listed order. Results attest structural consistency only; operation computes historical facts.

Verification.signature: Verification(head: Checkpoint, anchor_status: AnchorStatus, verified_events: int, canonical_event_bytes: int)
invariants: Zero events require zero bytes; nonzero events require verified_events <= canonical_event_bytes <= min(verified_events*16384,33554432), else inconsistent_chain
MATCHED_PREFIX requires nonzero head.sequence, else invalid_schema
Verification.limits: No supplied expected anchor exists in constructor; status is a structurally admitted assertion, not proof of its truth.

PageVerification.signature: PageVerification(after: Checkpoint, reached_terminal: bool, resolved: list[EventReference] | tuple[EventReference,...], unresolved: list[EventReference] | tuple[EventReference,...], prior_global_uniqueness: Literal['not_verified'] = 'not_verified', prior_membership: Literal['not_verified'] = 'not_verified')
fields: resolved/unresolved: exact list or tuple, combined <=1024 references; check both container shapes and combined cap before validating items; process resolved before unresolved
invariants: References use exact public EventReference class with revalidated/copied scalar fields
Each reference has after.chain_id and 1 <= sequence < after.sequence, else inconsistent_reference

Index by both event_id and sequence across both tuples: identical repeated full reference within one tuple -> duplicate; partial/split/wrong-hash identity or identical reference in both tuples -> inconsistent_reference
Preserve each tuple order; operation emits first semantic citation order, constructor cannot reconstruct event citation order
PageVerification.limits: At most64events*16references=1024; no earlier membership/global uniqueness or caller terminal proof from construction.

Reconciliation.signature: Reconciliation(status: ReconciliationStatus, head: Checkpoint, observed: EventReference | None = None)
fields: observed: None or exact revalidated/copied EventReference
invariants: FOUND_EXACT requires observed; ABSENT_AT_UNCHANGED_HEAD and BASE_NOT_COVERED forbid observed; CONFLICT permits either; otherwise invalid_schema
Observed chain must equal head.chain_id and 1 <= observed.sequence <= head.sequence; at terminal its digest must equal head.head_hash; otherwise inconsistent_reference
Reconciliation.limits: Construction does not verify a database or proposal/base history.

reconcile_input_order: Refuse closed/poisoned Ledger first; copy/revalidate event through public encode/decode, then expected_before Checkpoint.

Before any store read: event.chain_id==expected_before.chain_id, event.sequence==expected_before.sequence+1, event.previous_hash==expected_before.head_hash; check in that order, any mismatch inconsistent_chain.

A self-consistent foreign-chain proposal/base reaches store classification as conflict. A valid generic event4097 paired with full checkpoint4096 may reconcile absent; this is not permission to append beyond the cap.
Fully verify one current store snapshot. Foreign store chain or covered base hash mismatch -> conflict/observed None; base.sequence>head.sequence -> base_not_covered/observed None.

Then look up proposal ID and next sequence. Same row with exact canonical bytes -> found_exact, observed row; otherwise existing ID row -> conflict/that observed row (priority), else existing next row -> conflict/that observed row.
Neither row and head==base -> absent_at_unchanged_head; impossible other contiguous state -> inconsistent_chain. Never mutate/replay.
